rows.text_en: Ministry of Finance and Economy (Tax Law Administration Team), 044-215-4151
Chapter 1 General Provisions <Amended Feb. 28, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(전자신고등의 방법ㆍ절차 등) 「국세기본법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제5조의2제2항에 따라 전자신고 또는 전자청구(이하 이 조에서 “전자신고등”이라 한다)로 과세표준 등을 신고할 수 있는 국세의 종목, 전자신고등의 방법 및 절차는 국세의 종목별 특성, 전자신고등에 필요한 기술적ㆍ지리적 여건 등을 고려하여 국세청장이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2020. 3. 13., 2021. 3. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Methods and Procedures for Electronic Filing, etc.) Pursuant to Article 5-2, Paragraph 2 of the Framework Act on National Taxes (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the types of national taxes for which the tax base, etc. may be reported via electronic filing or electronic request (hereinafter referred to as “electronic filing, etc.” in this Article), and the methods and procedures for electronic filing, etc., shall be determined and announced by the Commissioner of the National Tax Service, taking into consideration the characteristics of each type of national tax and the technical and geographical conditions necessary for electronic filing, etc. <Amended Mar. 13, 2020; Mar. 16, 2021>

[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
[Title Amended Mar. 13, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(기한연장신청) 「국세기본법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제3조에 따른 기한연장의 신청은 별지 제1호서식의 기한연장 승인 신청서에 따른다. <개정 2021. 3. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Application for Extension of Deadline) An application for extension of a deadline under Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on National Taxes (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be made using the Application for Approval of Extension of Deadline in Attached Form No. 1. <Amended Mar. 16, 2021>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(기한연장 승인ㆍ기각의 통지) 영 제4조에 따른 기한연장 승인(기각)의 통지는 별지 제2호서식의 기한연장 승인(기각) 통지서에 따른다. <개정 2021. 3. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Notice of Approval or Rejection of Extension of Deadline) Notice of approval (or rejection) of an extension of deadline pursuant to Article 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Approval (or Rejection) of Extension of Deadline Form No. 2. <Amended Mar. 16, 2021>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Article 2-2 Deleted <Mar. 16, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(송달받을 장소의 신고) 영 제5조에 따른 송달받을 장소의 신고(변경신고를 포함한다)는 별지 제3호서식의 송달 장소(변경) 신고서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Notification of place of service) The notification of the place of service pursuant to Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree (including a notification of change) shall be in accordance with the Notification of Place of Service (Change) in Form No. 3 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(전자송달의 신청 등) 영 제6조의2제1항에 따른 전자송달의 신청 및 신청철회, 그 밖에 법 제5조의2제2항에 따른 국세정보통신망의 이용신청은 별지 제3호의2서식의 홈택스 이용신청서에 따른다. <개정 2021. 3. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Application for Electronic Service, etc.) Applications for electronic service and withdrawal of such application pursuant to Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, and other applications for the use of the National Tax Information Communication Network pursuant to Article 5-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act, shall be made using the Hometax Use Application Form in Annex 3-2 . <Amended Mar. 16, 2021>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(송달서) 법 제10조에 따른 송달과 영 제7조의2에 따른 부재중 확인은 별지 제4호서식의 송달서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Document for Service) Service under Article 10 of the Act and confirmation of absence under Article 7-2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Service Form in Attached Form No. 4.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(공시송달) 법 제11조제1항에 따른 공고는 별지 제5호서식의 공시송달서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Service by Public Notice) The public notice pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Service by Public Notice Form No. 5 attached hereto .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제5조의2(법인으로 보는 단체의 신청ㆍ승인 등) ① 영 제8조제1항에 따른 법인으로 보는 단체의 승인신청은 별지 제6호서식의 법인으로 보는 단체의 승인신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Application and Approval, etc. for Organizations Deemed to be Corporations) ① An application for approval of an organization deemed to be a corporation pursuant to Article 8 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the application for approval of an organization deemed to be a corporation in Form No. 6 of the Appendix .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제8조제2항에 따른 법인으로 보는 단체의 승인 여부 통지는 별지 제6호의2서식의 법인으로 보는 단체의 승인 여부 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The notification of approval or rejection of an organization deemed to be a corporation pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notification of Approval or Rejection of an Organization Deemed to be a Corporation in Form No. 6-2 of the Appendix.

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제8조제4항에 따른 법인으로 보는 단체의 승인 취소의 통지는 별지 제6호의3서식의 법인으로 보는 단체의 승인 취소 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The notice of cancellation of approval of an organization deemed to be a corporation pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Cancellation of Approval of an Organization Deemed to be a Corporation in Form No. 6-3 of the Appendix.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(법인으로 보는 단체의 대표자등의 선임신고) 영 제9조에 따른 법인으로 보는 단체의 대표자등의 선임신고 또는 변경신고는 별지 제6호의4서식의 법인으로 보는 단체의 대표자등의 선임(변경)신고서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Notification of Appointment of Representative, etc. of an Organization Treated as a Corporation) The notification of appointment or change of representative, etc. of an organization treated as a corporation pursuant to Article 9 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notification of Appointment (Change) of Representative, etc. of an Organization Treated as a Corporation in Form No. 6-4 of the Appendix .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(법인으로 보는 단체의 국세에 관한 의무를 이행하는 사람의 지정통지) 영 제9조의2에 따른 국세에 관한 의무를 이행하는 사람의 지정통지는 별지 제7호서식의 법인으로 보는 단체의 국세에 관한 의무 이행자 지정통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Notice of Designation of Person Performing National Tax Obligations of an Organization Treated as a Corporation) The notice of designation of a person performing national tax obligations pursuant to Article 9-2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Designation of Person Performing National Tax Obligations of an Organization Treated as a Corporation in Form No. 7 of the Appendix .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Article 7-2 (National Tax Ruling Review Committee) ① Deleted <Mar. 13, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 위원장은 영 제9조의3제1항의 사항을 심의하기 위하여 필요하면 관련 전문가 등의 의견을 들을 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson may hear the opinions of relevant experts, etc., if necessary to deliberate on the matters under Article 9-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Chapter 2 Tax Liability <Amended Feb. 28, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(상속인 대표자 신고 등) ① 영 제12조제1항에 따른 대표자신고는 별지 제8호서식의 상속인 대표자 신고서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Reporting of Representative of Heirs, etc.) ① The report of a representative pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Report of Representative of Heirs in Form No. 8 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제12조제2항에 따른 상속인 대표자 지정통지는 별지 제9호서식의 상속인 대표자 지정통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The notice of designation of a representative of heirs pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Designation of Representative of Heirs in Form No. 9 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Article 9 Deleted <Mar. 16, 2021>
Article 10 Deleted <Mar. 16, 2021>
Article 11 Deleted <Mar. 16, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제11조의2(국세 등에 우선하는 채권을 가진 자에 대한 통지) 영 제18조제4항에 따른 압류사실 통지는 별지 제15호의2서식의 압류사실 통지서에 따른다. <개정 2023. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 11-2 (Notice to Persons Holding Claims Prior to National Taxes, etc.) The notice of seizure pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Seizure Form No. 15-2 . <Amended Mar. 20, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의3(가등기권리자에 대한 압류 통지 등) ① 영 제18조제5항에 따른 가등기권리자에 대한 압류의 통지에 관하여는 「국세징수법 시행규칙」 제30조를 준용한다. <개정 2021. 3. 16., 2023. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 11-3 (Notice of Attachment, etc. to a Holder of a Provisional Registration Right) ① Article 30 of the Enforcement Rules of the National Tax Collection Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the notice of attachment to a holder of a provisional registration right pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended Mar. 16, 2021; Mar. 20, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제18조제5항에 따른 직전 보유자 국세 체납액의 구체적인 범위 설정을 위한 계산 기준일은 공매의 배분기일 또는 경매의 배당기일로 한다. <신설 2023. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: ② The reference date for calculating the specific scope of the immediately preceding holder's delinquent national taxes under Article 18(5) of the Enforcement Decree shall be the date for distributing proceeds from a public sale or the date for allocating proceeds at an auction. <Newly added Mar. 20, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 계산된 금액으로 국세 체납액 징수를 하는 경우 그 징수 요구에 관하여는 「국세징수법 시행규칙」 제48조를 준용한다. <신설 2023. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where delinquent national taxes are collected based on the amount calculated pursuant to Paragraph 2, Article 48 of the Enforcement Rules of the National Tax Collection Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the demand for such collection. <Newly added Mar. 20, 2023>

[This Article newly inserted Mar. 7, 2016]
[Title amended Mar. 20, 2023]
Chapter 3 Taxation <Amended Feb. 28, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(과세표준수정신고서 등) ① 영 제25조제2항제3호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 것”이란 「법인세법」 제44조, 제46조, 제47조 및 제47조의2에 따라 합병, 분할, 물적분할 및 현물출자에 따른 양도차익[「법인세법」(법률 제9898호 법인세법 일부개정법률로 개정되기 전의 것을 말한다) 제44조 및 제46조에 따른 합병평가차익 또는 분할평가차익을 포함한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다]에 대하여 과세를 이연(移延)받는 경우로서 세무조정 과정에서 양도차익의 전부 또는 일부에 상당하는 금액을 익금과 손금에 동시에 산입하지 아니한 것을 말한다. 다만, 다음 각 호의 모두에 해당하는 경우는 제외한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Amended Tax Base Return, etc.) ① In Article 25(2)3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to a case in which taxation on gains from transfers arising from a merger, division, spin-off or contribution in kind is deferred under Articles 44, 46, 47 and 47-2 of the Corporate Tax Act [including merger or division valuation gains under Articles 44 and 46 of the Corporate Tax Act prior to its amendment by Act No. 9898; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph] and an amount equivalent to all or part of those gains was not included simultaneously in gross income and deductible expenses during tax adjustment. However, this excludes cases meeting both of the following conditions. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정당한 사유 없이 「법인세법 시행령」 제80조, 제82조, 제83조의2, 제84조 및 제84조의2에 따라 과세특례를 신청하지 아니한 경우[「법인세법 시행령」(대통령령 제22184호 법인세법 시행령 일부개정령으로 개정되기 전의 것을 말한다) 제80조, 제82조, 제83조 및 제83조의2에 따라 과세특례를 적용받기 위한 관련 명세서를 제출하지 아니한 경우를 포함한다]
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where an application for special tax treatment is not made pursuant to Articles 80 , 82 , 83-2 , 84 , and 84-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Corporate Tax Act without justifiable grounds [including cases where relevant statements for the application of special tax treatment are not submitted pursuant to Articles 80 , 82 , 83 , and 83-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Corporate Tax Act (referring to the version prior to amendment by Presidential Decree No. 22184, the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Corporate Tax Act)]

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제29조 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases falling under any of the subparagraphs of Article 29 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제25조에 따른 과세표준수정신고서와 영 제26조에 따른 추가자진납부계산서는 별지 제16호서식과 같다. 다만, 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 각 호의 구분에 따른 서식에 원래 신고한 내용과 수정신고의 내용을 함께 적고 납부세액란 옆에 추가자진납부세액을 부기(附記)한 후 이에 각각 수정신고서 또는 추가자진납부 세액계산서로 표시함으로써 별지 제16호서식을 대신한다. <개정 2021. 10. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The amended tax return pursuant to Article 25 of the Enforcement Decree and the calculation statement for additional voluntary tax payment pursuant to Article 26 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 16 of the Attached Form. However, in any of the cases falling under any of the following subparagraphs, Form No. 16 of the Attached Form shall be replaced by recording the contents of the original return and the amended return together in the form specified in each subparagraph, noting the additional voluntary tax payment amount next to the column for tax payable, and labeling it, respectively, as the amended return or calculation statement for additional voluntary tax payment. <Amended Oct. 28, 2021>
1. Value Added Tax: Form No. 21 of the Enforcement Rules of the Value Added Tax Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 개별소비세: 「개별소비세법 시행규칙」 별지 제6호서식(부표를 포함한다), 별지 제7호서식, 별지 제7호의2서식 또는 별지 제7호의3서식
rows.text_en: 2. Individual Consumption Tax: Form No. 6 (including the attached table) of the Enforcement Rules of the Individual Consumption Tax Act, Form No. 7 , Form No. 7-2 , or Form No. 7-3
3. Traffic, Energy, and Environment Tax: Form No. 4 of the Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy, and Environment Tax Act
[Wholly Amended Mar. 14, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제12조의2(경정 등의 청구) 영 제25조의3에 따른 결정 또는 경정의 청구는 별지 제16호의2서식의 과세표준 및 세액의 결정(경정) 청구서에 최초의 과세표준 및 세액신고서 사본과 경정청구 사유를 객관적으로 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12-2 (Claim for Correction, etc.) A claim for determination or correction pursuant to Article 25-3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made by attaching a copy of the original tax base and tax amount declaration form and documents that can objectively prove the grounds for the claim for correction to the claim for determination (correction) of tax base and tax amount in Form No. 16-2 of the Appendix .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Article 12-3 Deleted <Mar. 16, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(가산세의 감면 등 신청) ① 영 제28조제2항에 따른 가산세의 감면 등의 신청은 별지 제17호서식의 가산세 감면 등 신청서에 따른다. <개정 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Application for Reduction, Exemption, etc. of Additional Taxes) ① An application for reduction, exemption, etc. of additional taxes pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Application for Reduction, Exemption, etc. of Additional Taxes in Annex 17. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제28조제4항에 따른 가산세 감면 등의 승인 여부 통지는 별지 제18호서식의 가산세 감면 등에 대한 승인 여부 통지서에 따른다. <개정 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: ② The notification of approval or rejection of reduction or exemption, etc. of additional taxes pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Approval or Rejection of Reduction or Exemption, etc. of Additional Taxes in Annex 18. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Chapter 4 National Tax Refunds and Interest on National Tax Refunds
Article 13-2 Deleted <February 28, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(국세환급금의 충당통지 등) ① 영 제31조에 따른 충당통지는 별지 제19호서식의 국세환급금 충당통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Notice of Offset of National Tax Refunds, etc.) ① The notice of offset pursuant to Article 31 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Offset of National Tax Refunds in Form No. 19 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제51조제2항에 따른 국세환급금의 충당동의 및 같은 조 제4항에 따른 충당청구는 별지 제19호의2서식의 국세환급금 충당 청구서(동의서)에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The consent to offset of national tax refunds pursuant to Article 51 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and the claim for offset pursuant to Paragraph 4 of the same Article shall be in accordance with the claim for offset of national tax refunds (consent form) in Form No. 19-2 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제14조의2(착오ㆍ이중납부에 대한 환급청구) 영 제33조제3항에 따른 환급청구는 별지 제20호서식의 국세환급금 환급신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 14-2 (Claim for Refund due to Error or Double Payment) A claim for refund pursuant to Article 33, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Application for Refund of National Tax in Form No. 20 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(국세환급금의 환급) 다음 각 호의 국세환급금의 지급통지 등은 별지 제21호서식의 국세환급금지급통지ㆍ계좌이체입금(현금지급) 요구 및 지급내역통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Refund of National Tax Refunds) The notice of payment, etc. for national tax refunds under each of the following subparagraphs shall be in accordance with the Notice of Payment of National Tax Refund, Request for Deposit via Account Transfer (Cash Payment), and Notice of Payment Details Form No. 21 attached hereto .
1. Notice of payment of national tax refund pursuant to Article 33 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제34조제2항 및 제4항 본문에 따른 국세환급금의 계좌이체입금 요구
rows.text_en: 2. Request for bank transfer of national tax refunds pursuant to the main text of Article 34, Paragraphs 2 and 4 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 제34조제3항에 따른 국세환급금의 계좌이체 입금통지 또는 계좌이체 입금불가능사실의 통지
rows.text_en: 3. Notification of deposit of national tax refund via bank transfer pursuant to Article 34 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree or notification of the fact that bank transfer deposit is impossible

rows.source_ko: 4. 영 제35조제2항에 따른 국세환급금의 현금지급 요구
rows.text_en: 4. Demand for cash payment of national tax refunds pursuant to Article 35 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 5. 영 제35조제3항에 따른 국세환급금의 지급명세 통지
rows.text_en: 5. Notification of payment details of national tax refunds pursuant to Article 35 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Article 16 Deleted <Mar. 31, 2001>

rows.source_ko: 제16조의2(세무서장 소관 세입금계정 간의 조정) ① 영 제33조의2제1항 전단에 따른 세입금 이체 수입 신청은 별지 제44호서식의 세입금 이체 수입 신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 16-2 (Adjustment between revenue accounts under the jurisdiction of the head of the tax office) ① The application for revenue transfer pursuant to the first part of Article 33-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the application for revenue transfer in Form No. 44 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제33조의2제1항 후단에 따른 세입금이체명령서는 별지 제45호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The order for transfer of revenue pursuant to the latter part of Article 33-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 45 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제33조의2제1항 후단에 따른 세입금 이체 명령 통지는 별지 제46호서식의 세입금 이체 명령 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The notice of order to transfer revenue pursuant to the latter part of Article 33-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Order to Transfer Revenue in Form No. 46 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제33조의2제2항에 따른 세입금이체청구서는 별지 제47호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ④ The claim for transfer of revenue pursuant to Article 33-2 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 47 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제33조의2제3항에 따른 세입금 이체사실의 통지는 별지 제48호서식의 세입금 이체사실 통지서 및 별지 제49호서식의 세입금 이체사실 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The notification of the fact of transfer of revenue pursuant to Article 33-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notification of the Fact of Transfer of Revenue in Form No. 48 and the Notification of the Fact of Transfer of Revenue in Form No. 49 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제16조의3(계좌개설신고) 영 제34조제1항에 따른 계좌개설신고(계좌변경신고를 포함한다)는 별지 제22호서식의 계좌개설(변경) 신고서에 따른다. 다만, 법 및 세법에 따른 과세표준신고서에 납세자 명의의 환급계좌를 기재한 경우 해당 환급 신고분에 대해서는 계좌개설을 신고한 것으로 본다. <개정 2023. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 16-3 ( Notification of Account Opening ) The notification of account opening (including the notification of account change) pursuant to Article 34 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Account Opening (Change) Notification Form in Annex 22. However, if a refund account in the name of the taxpayer is indicated in the tax base declaration form pursuant to the Act and tax laws, the account opening shall be deemed to have been reported for the said refund portion. <Amended Mar. 20, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(납세자에 대한 환급통지) ① 영 제36조에 따른 국세환급금통지서는 별지 제24호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Notice of Refund to Taxpayer) ① The notice of national tax refund pursuant to Article 36 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 24 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 국세환급금통지서의 송달을 우편으로 하는 경우에는 등기우편으로 해야 한다. 다만, 국세환급금이 5만원 미만인 경우에는 일반우편으로 송달할 수 있다. <개정 2021. 3. 16., 2025. 3. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② When delivering a notice of national tax refund pursuant to Paragraph 1 by mail, it shall be done by registered mail. However, if the national tax refund is less than 50,000 won, it may be delivered by ordinary mail. <Amended Mar. 16, 2021; Mar. 21, 2025>
1. Deleted <March 16, 2021>
2. Deleted <March 16, 2021>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제18조(미지급자금의 세입편입) 영 제39조에 따른 지급하지 못한 금액의 세입납입은 지급기간이 지난 날이 속하는 달의 다음 달 말일까지 일반회계 잡수입(雜收入)으로 소관 세입징수관계정에 납입하는 방법으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Inclusion of Unpaid Funds in Revenue) The revenue of unpaid amounts pursuant to Article 39 of the Enforcement Decree shall be paid into the relevant revenue collection officer's account as miscellaneous revenue of the general account by the end of the month following the month in which the payment period has expired.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제19조(국세환급금 등의 양도 요구) 영 제43조의4제1항에 따른 국세환급금 등의 양도 요구는 별지 제24호의2서식의 국세환급금 양도 요구서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Request for Transfer of National Tax Refunds, etc.) A request for the transfer of national tax refunds, etc. pursuant to Article 43-4, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made in accordance with the request for transfer of national tax refunds form No. 24-2 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의2(물납재산의 환급신청) 영 제43조의2제1항에 따른 물납(物納)재산의 환급신청은 별지 제25호서식의 물납재산 환급신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 19-2 (Application for Refund of Property Paid in Kind) An application for the refund of property paid in kind pursuant to Article 43-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Application for Refund of Property Paid in Kind Form No. 25 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

Article 19-3 (Interest Rate on National Tax Refunds) In the main text of Article 43-3(2) of the Enforcement Decree, the “interest rate prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” means 31 per 1,000 per annum (3.1% per annum). <Amended Feb. 23, 2013; Mar. 14, 2014; Mar. 6, 2015; Mar. 7, 2016; Mar. 15, 2017; Mar. 19, 2018; Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 13, 2020; Mar. 16, 2021; Mar. 20, 2023; Mar. 22, 2024; Mar. 21, 2025; Jan. 2, 2026>
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제20조(준용규정) 이 장의 규정 외에 국세환급금 등의 환급에 필요한 사항은 「국고금관리법 시행규칙」을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Applicable Provisions) In addition to the provisions of this Chapter, matters necessary for the refund of national tax refunds, etc. shall be governed by the Enforcement Rules of the National Treasury Management Act .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Chapter 5 Examination and Adjudication <Amended Feb. 28, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제20조의2(「행정심판법」의 준용) 법 제56조제1항 단서 및 제81조의15제7항에 따라 심사청구, 심판청구 또는 과세전적부심사(課稅前適否審査)에 대하여 「행정심판법」을 준용하는 경우에 사용하는 서식은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 20-2 (Application of the Administrative Appeals Act) The forms to be used in cases where the Administrative Appeals Act is applied mutatis mutandis to a request for review, a request for appeal, or a pre-assessment suitability review pursuant to the proviso to Article 56, Paragraph 1 and Article 81-15, Paragraph 7 of the Act are as follows: <Amended Mar. 20, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「행정심판법」 제15조제1항에 따른 선정대표자 선정: 별지 제25호의2서식의 선정대표자 선정서
rows.text_en: 1. Selection of Representative Pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Appeals Act : Form for Selection of Representative (Form No. 25-2 )

rows.source_ko: 2. 「행정심판법」 제15조제5항에 따른 선정대표자 해임: 별지 제25호의3서식의 선정대표자 해임서
rows.text_en: 2. Dismissal of the Appointed Representative pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 5 of the Administrative Appeals Act : Form for Dismissal of Appointed Representative (Form No. 25-3)

rows.source_ko: 3. 「행정심판법」 제16조제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따른 청구인지위 승계신고: 별지 제25호의4서식의 청구인 지위 승계신고서
rows.text_en: 3. Notification of Succession of Claimant Status pursuant to Article 16 , Paragraphs 1 through 3 of the Administrative Appeals Act : Notification of Succession of Claimant Status in Annex 25-4

rows.source_ko: 4. 「행정심판법」 제16조제5항에 따른 청구인지위 승계허가신청: 별지 제25호의5서식의 청구인 지위 승계허가신청서
rows.text_en: 4. Application for Permission to Successor Claimant Status Pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 5 of the Administrative Appeals Act : Application for Permission to Successor Claimant Status in Form No. 25-5

rows.source_ko: 5. 「행정심판법」 제20조제1항 및 제2항에 따른 심사ㆍ심판참가 신청: 별지 제25호의6서식의 (심사ㆍ심판)참가 신청서
rows.text_en: 5. Application for participation in examination/appeal pursuant to Article 20, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Administrative Appeals Act : Application for Participation (Examination/Appeal) in Form No. 25-6

rows.source_ko: 6. 「행정심판법」 제20조제6항 및 같은 법 시행령 제17조에 따른 심사ㆍ심판참가신청 거부에 대한 이의신청: 별지 제25호의7서식의 (심사ㆍ심판)참가 신청 거부에 대한 이의신청서
rows.text_en: 6. Objection to the Refusal of Application for Participation in Examination or Appeal Pursuant to Article 20 , Paragraph 6 of the Administrative Appeals Act and Article 17 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act : Objection to the Refusal of Application for Participation (Examination or Appeal) in Form No. 25-7

rows.source_ko: 7. 「행정심판법」 제21조제1항 및 같은 법 시행령 제18조에 따른 참가 요구: 별지 제25호의8서식의 국세심사위원회ㆍ조세심판관(합동)회의 참가 요구서
rows.text_en: 7. Request for participation pursuant to Article 21 , Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Appeals Act and Article 18 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act : Request for participation in the National Tax Review Committee and Tax Appeals Judges (Joint) Meeting (Form No. 25-8 )

rows.source_ko: 8. 「행정심판법」 제29조제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따른 청구변경신청: 별지 제25호의9서식의 청구변경 신청서
rows.text_en: 8. Application for Amendment of Claim pursuant to Articles 29, Paragraphs 1 through 3 of the Administrative Appeals Act : Application for Amendment of Claim in Form No. 25-9

rows.source_ko: 9. 「행정심판법」 제36조제1항에 따른 출석 요청: 별지 제25호의10서식의 국세심사위원회ㆍ조세심판관(합동)회의 출석 요청서
rows.text_en: 9. Request for Attendance Pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Appeals Act : Request for Attendance at the National Tax Review Committee & Tax Appeals Judges (Joint) Meeting (Form No. 25-10 )

rows.source_ko: 10. 「행정심판법」 제40조제1항 단서 및 같은 법 시행령 제27조에 따른 구술심리신청: 별지 제25호의11서식의 구술심리 신청서
rows.text_en: 10. Application for oral hearing pursuant to the proviso to Article 40 , Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Appeals Act and Article 27 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act : Application for oral hearing in Form No. 25-11

rows.source_ko: 11. 「행정심판법」 제40조제2항에 따른 구술심리 허가 여부 통지: 별지 제25호의12서식의 국세심사위원회ㆍ조세심판관(합동)회의 구술심리 허가 여부 통지서
rows.text_en: 11. Notification of Permission for Oral Hearing Pursuant to Article 40 , Paragraph 2 of the Administrative Appeals Act : Notification of Permission for Oral Hearing by the National Tax Review Committee and the (Joint) Meeting of Tax Appeal Judges ( Form No. 25-12 )
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제21조(의견진술) ① 영 제47조제1항에 따른 의견진술신청은 별지 제26호서식의 의견진술 신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Statement of Opinion) ① An application for a statement of opinion pursuant to Article 47 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Application for Statement of Opinion Form No. 26 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제47조제2항 및 제6항에 따라 출석통지를 서면으로 하는 경우에는 별지 제27호서식의 출석통지서에 따른다. <개정 2013. 2. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② In cases where notice of attendance is given in writing pursuant to Article 47, Paragraphs 2 and 6 of the Enforcement Decree, it shall be in accordance with the Notice of Attendance Form No. 27. <Amended Feb. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제47조제3항 및 제6항에 따라 의견진술신청의 기각(각하)통지를 서면으로 하는 경우에는 별지 제28호서식의 의견진술신청 기각(각하) 통지서에 따른다. <개정 2013. 2. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where the notice of dismissal (rejection) of an application for statement of opinion is made in writing pursuant to Article 47, Paragraphs 3 and 6 of the Enforcement Decree, it shall be in accordance with the Notice of Dismissal (Rejection) of Application for Statement of Opinion Form No. 28. <Amended Feb. 23, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제21조의2(국선대리인의 선정신청) 영 제48조의2제1항에 따른 국선대리인 선정의 신청은 별지 제28호의2서식의 국선대리인 선정 신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 21-2 (Application for Selection of a Publicly Appointed Representative) An application for the appointment of a representative at public expense under Article 48-2(1) of the Enforcement Decree shall be filed using the Application for Appointment of a Publicly Appointed Representative in Attached Form No. 28-2.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 6, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제22조(심사청구서) 영 제50조에 따른 심사청구서는 별지 제29호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Request for Examination) The request for examination pursuant to Article 50 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 29 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제23조(보정요구) 영 제52조에 따른 보정요구는 별지 제30호서식의 보정 요구서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Request for Correction) A request for correction pursuant to Article 52 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made in accordance with the Request for Correction Form No. 30 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Article 23-2 Deleted <Mar. 22, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제24조(심사결정) 법 제65조제3항에 따른 결정서는 별지 제31호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Decision on Examination) The decision form pursuant to Article 65, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 31 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제24조의2(결정의 경정신청) 법 제65조의2제1항(법 제81조에 따라 준용되는 경우를 포함한다)에 따른 결정의 경정신청은 별지 제31호의2서식의 국세심사ㆍ조세심판 결정 경정신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 24-2 (Application for Correction of Decision) An application for correction of a decision pursuant to Article 65-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (including cases where it is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 81 of the Act ) shall be made using the Application for Correction of Decision on National Tax Examination and Tax Appeal in Annex 31-2 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제25조(이의신청) ① 영 제54조제1항에 따른 이의신청은 별지 제32호서식의 이의신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Objection) ① An objection pursuant to Article 54, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the objection form in Annex 32 .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제66조제2항에 따른 이의신청서의 이송 통지는 별지 제33호서식의 이의신청서 이송 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The notice of transfer of an objection form pursuant to Article 66 , Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Notice of Transfer of Objection Form No. 33 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제66조제6항에 따른 결정의 통지는 별지 제34호서식에 따른다. <개정 2022. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: ③ The notice of a decision pursuant to Article 66, Paragraph 6 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 34 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 18, 2022>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제26조(심판청구) 영 제55조에 따른 심판청구는 별지 제35호서식의 조세심판청구서에 따른다. <개정 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Request for Tax Appeal) A request for tax appeal pursuant to Article 55 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Form for Tax Appeal in Annex 35. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제27조(답변서) 법 제69조제4항에 따른 답변서는 별지 제36호서식에 따른다. <개정 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Statement of Response) The statement of response pursuant to Article 69, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 36 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 20, 2019>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제27조의2(증거목록) 법 제69조제1항 및 제4항에 따라 심판청구서 및 답변서를 제출하거나 법 제71조제1항에 따른 항변서를 제출할 때 증거서류 또는 증거물이 있는 경우에는 별지 제36호의2서식의 증거목록을 함께 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 27-2 (List of Evidence) When submitting a tax appeal petition and a response pursuant to Article 69, Paragraphs 1 and 4 of the Act, or submitting a statement of defense pursuant to Article 71, Paragraph 1 of the Act, if there are evidentiary documents or materials, a list of evidence in the form of Annex 36-2 must be submitted together.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 20, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제28조(사건배정 및 심리개시 통지서) 법 제69조제6항에 따른 답변서의 부본송부, 영 제56조에 따른 항변자료의 제출요구와 영 제57조 본문에 따른 담당조세심판관의 지정 또는 변경통지는 별지 제37호서식의 사건배정 및 심리개시 통지서에 따른다. <개정 2013. 2. 23., 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Notice of Case Assignment and Commencement of Hearing) The transmission of a duplicate copy of the written answer pursuant to Article 69 , Paragraph 6 of the Act, the request for submission of materials for defense pursuant to Article 56 of the Enforcement Decree, and the notice of designation or change of the competent tax appeals judge pursuant to the main text of Article 57 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Case Assignment and Commencement of Hearing in Annex 37. <Amended Feb. 23, 2013; Mar. 20, 2019>

[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
[Title Amended Mar. 20, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제28조의2(항변 및 추가답변) ① 법 제71조제1항에 따른 항변은 별지 제37호의2서식의 항변서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 28-2 (Defense and Additional Response) ① A defense pursuant to Article 71, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with the defense statement in Form No. 37-2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제71조제3항에 따라 증거서류의 부본을 받은 피청구인은 별지 제37호의3서식의 청구인 항변에 대한 추가답변서를 조세심판원장에게 제출할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② A respondent who has received a duplicate copy of the evidentiary documents pursuant to Article 71, Paragraph 3 of the Act may submit an additional answer to the claimant's defense in the form of Annex 37-3 to the President of the Tax Tribunal.
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 20, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제29조(담당조세심판관의 기피신청) ① 영 제60조에 따른 담당조세심판관의 기피신청은 별지 제38호서식의 담당 조세심판관 기피 신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Application for Recusal of the Tax Tribunal Judge in Charge) ① An application for recusal of the tax tribunal judge in charge pursuant to Article 60 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made in accordance with the Application for Recusal of the Tax Tribunal Judge in Charge Form No. 38 .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항의 담당조세심판관 기피신청서에 대한 승인 또는 기각통지 및 재지정통지는 별지 제39호서식의 담당 조세심판관 기피 신청에 대한 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The notice of approval or rejection and the notice of reassignment regarding the application for recusal of the tax appeals judge in charge under Paragraph 1 shall be in accordance with the notice regarding the application for recusal of the tax appeals judge in charge in Form No. 39 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제30조(신분증명서) 법 제76조제3항에 따른 증표는 별지 제40호서식의 신분증명서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Identity Certificate) The identification certificate pursuant to Article 76, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 40 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제31조(결정서 등) ① 법 제78조제5항에 따른 결정서는 별지 제41호서식, 별지 제41호의2서식 및 별지 제41호의3서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Decision, etc.) ① The decision pursuant to Article 78 , Paragraph 5 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 41 , Form No. 41-2 , and Form No. 41-3 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제62조의2제6항에 따른 심리요청서는 별지 제41호의4서식과 같다. <신설 2017. 3. 15., 2019. 3. 20., 2020. 3. 13.>
rows.text_en: ② The request for hearing pursuant to Article 62-2, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 41-4 . <Newly added Mar. 15, 2017; Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 13, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제63조에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 방법”이란 「우편법 시행규칙」 제25조제1항제6호에 따른 특별송달방법을 말한다. <개정 2017. 3. 15., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 63 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “method prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the special service of documents pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 6 of the Enforcement Rules of the Postal Service Act . <Amended Mar. 15, 2017; Jan. 2, 2026>

[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
[Title Amended Mar. 15, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제32조(심판결정의 처리결과 보고) 조세심판원장으로부터 심판결정의 통지를 받은 관계행정기관의 장은 그 받은 날부터 14일내에 처리결과를 별지 제42호서식의 조세심판결정 처리결과 보고서에 따라 조세심판원장에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 32 (Reporting of Processing Results of Appeal Decisions) The head of a relevant administrative agency who has received notification of an appeal decision from the President of the Tax Tribunal shall report the processing results to the President of the Tax Tribunal within 14 days from the date of receipt, in accordance with the Report on Processing Results of Tax Appeal Decisions in Form No. 42 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Chapter 6 Supplementary Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제33조(납세관리인설정신고) 영 제64조에 따른 납세관리인설정신고 또는 변경신고는 별지 제43호서식의 납세관리인 설정ㆍ변경ㆍ해임신고서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 33 (Notification of Appointment of a Tax Administrator) The notification of establishment or change of tax administrator pursuant to Article 64 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notification of Establishment, Change, or Dismissal of Tax Administrator in Form No. 43 of the Appendix.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제33조의2(납세관리인신고확인서) 법 제82조제6항에 따른 확인서는 별지 제43호의2서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 33-2 (Certificate of Declaration of Tax Administrator) The certificate pursuant to Article 82, Paragraph 6 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 43-2 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제33조의3(납세관리인 지정 통지) 영 제64조제3항에 따른 납세관리인 지정 통지는 별지 제43호의3서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 33-3 (Notice of Designation of Tax Administrator) The notice of designation of a tax administrator pursuant to Article 64, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 43-3 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Apr. 11, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제34조(납세지도교부금) ① 영 제65조의2제1항에 따른 교부금지급신청서는 별지 제50호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 34 (Taxpayer Guidance Grant) ① The application form for payment of the grant pursuant to Article 65-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 50 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제65조의2제4항에 따른 교부금 지급 여부 결정 통지는 별지 제51호서식의 교부금 지급 여부 결정 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The notice of decision on whether to pay the grant pursuant to Article 65-2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Decision on Whether to Pay the Grant in Form No. 51 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제65조의2제5항에 따른 납세지도 사업실적 보고서는 별지 제52호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The report on the performance of tax guidance projects pursuant to Article 65-2, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 52 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제35조(세무조사의 통지) ① 영 제63조의6제1항에 따른 세무조사에 관한 사전 통지는 별지 제54호서식의 세무조사 사전 통지서에 따른다. <개정 2018. 3. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 35 (Notice of Tax Audit) ①Prior notice regarding a tax audit pursuant to Article 63-6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Prior Notice of Tax Audit Form No. 54. <Amended Mar. 19, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제81조의7제6항에 따른 세무조사통지서는 별지 제54호의2서식과 같다. <신설 2018. 3. 19., 2024. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The notice of tax audit pursuant to Article 81-7 , Paragraph 6 of the Act shall be in the form of Annex 54-2 . <Newly added Mar. 19, 2018; Mar. 22, 2024>

[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
[Title Amended Mar. 19, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제36조(세무조사의 연기신청) ① 영 제63조의7제2항에 따른 세무조사의 연기신청은 별지 제55호서식의 세무조사 연기신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 36 (Application for Postponement of Tax Audit) ① An application for postponement of a tax audit pursuant to Article 63-7, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Application for Postponement of Tax Audit Form No. 55 .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제81조의7제3항에 따른 세무조사의 연기신청에 관한 결과 통지는 별지 제55호의2서식의 세무조사 연기신청 결과 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The notification of the result regarding the application for postponement of a tax audit pursuant to Article 81-7, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Notification of the Result of the Application for Postponement of Tax Audit in Form No. 55-2 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제36조의2(세무조사 기간 연장 통지) 법 제81조의8제7항에 따른 세무조사 기간 연장 통지는 별지 제55호의3서식의 세무조사 기간 연장 통지서에 따른다. <개정 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 36-2 (Notice of Extension of Tax Audit Period) The notice of extension of the tax audit period pursuant to Article 81-8, Paragraph 7 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Notice of Extension of Tax Audit Period in Annex 55-3 . <Amended Mar. 20, 2019>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
Article 36-3 Deleted <February 28, 2012>
Article 36-4 Deleted <February 28, 2012>
Article 36-5 Deleted <February 28, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제37조(세무조사의 결과 통지) 법 제81조의12에 따른 세무조사의 결과 통지는 별지 제56호서식의 세무조사 결과 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 37 (Notice of Results of Tax Audit) The notice of results of a tax audit pursuant to Article 81-12 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Notice of Results of Tax Audit Form No. 56 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제37조의2(과세정보제공요구서) 법 제81조의13제2항에 따라 같은 조 제1항제1호ㆍ제2호 및 제5호부터 제9호까지의 어느 하나에 해당하여 과세정보의 제공을 요구하는 자는 별지 제56호의2서식(1)의 과세정보제공요구서를 해당 세무관서의 장에게 제출해야 한다. 다만, 둘 이상의 납세자의 과세정보의 제공을 요구하는 경우에는 별지 제56호의2서식(2)을 함께 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 37-2 (Request for Provision of Tax Information) Pursuant to Article 81-13, Paragraph 2 of the Act, any person requesting the provision of tax information in accordance with any of subparagraphs 1, 2, and 5 through 9 of Paragraph 1 of the same Article shall submit a request for the provision of tax information in the form of Annex 56-2 (1) to the head of the relevant tax office. However, if the provision of tax information for two or more taxpayers is requested, Annex 56-2 (2) must be submitted together.

[This Article was newly added on Mar. 18, 2022.]
[Formerly Article 37-2 was moved to Article 37-3 <Mar. 18, 2022>]

rows.source_ko: 제37조의3(과세전적부심사의 청구절차 등) ① 법 제81조의15제2항에 따른 과세전적부심사의 청구는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서식에 따른다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2022. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 37-3 (Procedures for Requesting Pre-assessment Review, etc.) ① A request for a pre-assessment review pursuant to Article 81-15, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be made in accordance with the forms prescribed by the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 18, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 세무서장이나 지방국세청장에게 청구하는 경우: 별지 제56호의3서식의 과세전적부심사 청구서
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of filing a claim with the Head of a Tax Office or the Head of a Regional Tax Office: Request for Pre-Assessment Review Form No. 56-3

rows.source_ko: 2. 국세청장에게 청구하는 경우: 별지 제56호의4서식의 과세전적부심사 청구서(국세청용)
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of a claim to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service: Form No. 56-4 (For the National Tax Service)

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제81조의15제8항에 따른 과세표준 및 세액의 조기 결정 또는 경정결정의 신청은 별지 제56호의5서식의 조기결정 신청서에 따른다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2022. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: ② An application for early determination or corrective determination of the tax base and tax amount pursuant to Paragraph 8 of Article 81-15 of the Act shall be made using the Application for Early Determination in Annex 56-5 . <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 18, 2022>

[Wholly Amended Feb. 28, 2012]
[Moved from Article 37-2; former Article 37-3 moved to Article 37-4 <Mar. 18, 2022>]

rows.source_ko: 제37조의4(납세자보호위원회에 대한 납세자의 심의 등의 요청 및 결과 통지 등) ① 법 제81조의19제1항에 따른 납세자의 심의 요청 및 같은 조 제5항에 따른 취소 또는 변경 요청은 별지 제56호의6서식의 권리보호 심의 요청서에 따른다. <개정 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 37-4 (Request for Deliberation, etc. by a Taxpayer to the Taxpayer Protection Committee and Notification of Results, etc.) ① A taxpayer's request for deliberation pursuant to Paragraph 1 of Article 81-19 of the Act and a request for cancellation or modification pursuant to Paragraph 5 of the same Article shall be made using the Request for Deliberation on Protection of Rights Form No. 56-6 . <Amended Mar. 18, 2022; Mar. 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제81조의19제3항 및 같은 조 제6항에 따른 결과의 통지는 별지 제56호의7서식의 권리보호 심의 요청 결과 통지서에 따른다. <개정 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: ② The notification of results pursuant to Paragraph 3 and Paragraph 6 of Article 81-19 of the Act shall be in accordance with the Notification of Results of Request for Deliberation on Protection of Rights in Annex 56-7 . <Amended Mar. 18, 2022; Mar. 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제81조의19제10항에 따른 의견 진술의 신청은 별지 제56호의8서식의 의견진술 신청서에 따른다. <개정 2022. 3. 18., 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: ③ An application for the statement of opinion pursuant to Article 81-19 , Paragraph 10 of the Act shall be made using the Application for Statement of Opinion in Annex 56-8 . <Amended Mar. 18, 2022; Mar. 20, 2026>

[This Article was newly added on Mar. 19, 2018]
[Moved from Article 37-3 <Mar. 18, 2022>]

rows.source_ko: 제38조(불성실기부금수령단체 등 명단공개 사전통지) ① 법 제85조의5제1항제2호에 따른 불성실기부금수령단체에 같은 조 제4항에 따라 명단공개 대상자임을 통지하는 경우에는 별지 제57호서식의 불성실기부금수령단체 명단공개 사전통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 38 (Advance Notice of Public Disclosure of Noncompliant Donation-Receiving Organizations, etc.) ① When notifying a noncompliant donation-receiving organization under Article 85-5(1)2 of the Act that it is subject to public disclosure of its name pursuant to paragraph (4) of that Article, the advance notice shall be given using the Advance Notice of Disclosure of Noncompliant Donation-Receiving Organizations in Attached Form No. 57.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제85조의5제1항제4호에 따른 해외금융계좌 신고의무 위반자에게 같은 조 제4항에 따라 명단공개 대상자임을 통지하는 경우에는 별지 제57호의2서식의 해외금융계좌 신고의무 위반자 명단공개 사전통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② When notifying a violator of the obligation to report overseas financial accounts under Article 85-5, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act that they are subject to public disclosure of the list pursuant to Paragraph 4 of the same Article, it shall be done in accordance with the prior notice of public disclosure of the list of persons who failed to comply with the obligation to report overseas financial accounts in Form No. 57-2 of the Appendix.
[Wholly Amended Mar. 16, 2021]

rows.source_ko: ①(시행일) 이 영은 법률 제2679호 국세기본법의 시행일로부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: ① (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall apply from the enforcement date of Act No. 2679, the Basic Act on National Taxes.

rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures) Documents prepared and submitted using the previous forms prior to March 10, 1975, shall be deemed to have been prepared using the forms of this Decree.

rows.source_ko: ③(다른 법령과의 관계) 다른 법령에서 종전의 국세징수법시행규칙의 규정을 인용한 경우에 이 영중 그에 해당되는 조항이 있는 때에는 그에 갈음하여 이 영의 해당 조항을 인용한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Relationship with other laws and regulations) Where other laws and regulations cite the provisions of the former Enforcement Rules of the National Tax Collection Act, and there are corresponding provisions in this Decree, it shall be deemed that the relevant provisions of this Decree have been cited in lieu thereof.
